At our evening meeting on May 20th, eight Club handicaps were held, and a noticeable feature was the double successes of three members, G. Basford, B.

However, we look forward to next year's meeting and guarantee to give them a fine fight in trying to regain possession of our lost honours. With regard to the Handicaps, the Club was more successful in these, and we gained first and second places in the 100 Yards with B.

We certainly started the season very well at Gravesend (even if the S.L.H. did "slip up" over their teams (we have memories of a similar happening at Chislehurst; ask Bert Footer!), and we are sorry that Bruce Hayman, who did the "double" there, is leaving us in the near future.

One such man was Bruce Hayman who as one of our top sprinters in the late '20s and early '30s.
